# W3C Digital Network

> Practical digital services operated personally by JAKE. CAC registered in Nigeria (RC 9579098). Primary site: https://web3currency.online. WhatsApp is the digital office.

W3C Digital Network is not an exchange, broker, or investment platform. W3C DESK is a direct peer-to-peer service for buying and selling supported crypto, coordinated directly with JAKE. W3C does not offer managed trading, guaranteed returns, passive-income products, or investment custody. W3C may temporarily receive fiat or crypto sent for a specific transaction for settlement, but does not accept customer assets for investment, yield, or safekeeping.
